newsitem.title: USA: People's Choice TV may be delisted.
newsitem.headline: People's Choice TV may be delisted.

text.p: People's Choice TV Corp on Thursday said Nasdaq officials have determined its common is not eligible for listing on the Nasdaq SmallCap Market.

The company said it has negative tangible net assets as calculated pursuant to Nasdaq's National Market System listing criteria. Nasdaq officials have denied the company's request for a waiver of the net tangible assets requirement, People's said.
The company said it plans to appeal the determination. Its stock will continue to trade on Nasdaq during the appeal.
